summary: Validated SELISIH backend APIs and desktop/mobile browser flows. Seed totals, comparison rules, persistence, paste previews, Nota Retur, supplier sharing, and responsive expansion passed.
action_items: Consider adding a cleanup strategy or isolated database for API test data; the POST test persists TEST-REK and changes the seeded dashboard count/total.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend create endpoint has no delete/reset operation, so externally created test records cannot be cleaned up through the public API.
Frontend request errors are not handled with an app-level Indonesian error state; Axios failures can surface the development runtime error overlay.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-REK API record for persistence testing; it remains because no delete endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Initial UI assertion expected exactly 3 rows/Rp 60.500.000, but the persistence test added TEST-REK (Rp 6.000), yielding 4 rows/Rp 60.506.000. Valid dashboard links and all tested flows pass. A manually typed reference instead of reconciliation id correctly returned 404 and showed the CRA development overlay; this was a test mistake, not a seeded-link failure.
rca of the issue: Test data persistence is expected from POST but there is no public cleanup endpoint. API behavior itself passed create-to-GET verification. Browser API errors are unhandled in components, so invalid IDs show a development runtime overlay rather than a friendly Indonesian not-found state.
